event.description: Replace the 15x14 tied token table with a rank-4 learned token code expanded through a fixed DCT basis, preserving tied input/output token vectors and the retained d=14, h=2, L=2, ff=20, rank-8 position architecture.
event.proposal: Family: token representation. Retained incumbent is 3430 parameters at 99.660000%, a +0.660000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: no accepted token-representation candidate and no failed token-representation candidate; 0 prior attempts in this family. Hypothesis: the 15 token identities may need only a small learned code because the fixed DCT expansion supplies a stable 14-dimensional residual representation, while constructing output logits from the same expanded table retains input/output tying. This is a representational substitution, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning; it removes 150 actual learned parameters (3430 to 3280). This repairs the unlogged sandbox Git-index failure in the prior launch before any training or verification occurred. It is more informative than the nearest untested alternative rank 3 because rank 4 is the largest rank that genuinely reduces the tied token representation and isolates whether token-space rank is redundant.
